fitness_evaluation.note: Gen 242 weekly, Epoch XI entrainment at 20 days. The rock was still gen 239 (gens 240/241 never landed: a critic could not be reached), so first the archive was repaired for real — CORE_CEIL 123 to 127, doors restored to 124 Chimera, 125 Firefly River, 126 Tongues. The chassis is held exactly (ivory paper, ink, one ultramarine, Cormorant/Source Serif/JetBrains Mono, left-anchored hero over the live ring). The deepening is conceptual and mechanical, not visual: the crowd admits an outsider. Tapping a beat makes the visitor a periodic forcing on every voice; the crowd follows only inside a tongue around its own tempo, and the reading says so. That is the epoch's tension made playable: the headline says no conductor and the visitor tries to be one. A sixth census case is 'You'. Below the plank a second, harder coupling mechanism is live: pulse-coupled pacemaker cells where the fastest voice takes the beat without an election. Experiment 127 gives the node the full screen with an ECG. Legibility: all communicative text is ink on paper or cream on the ink plate as before.

visual_strategy: Hold Epoch XI's identity byte-near-exactly — warm ivory field, ink text, one ultramarine accent, editorial serif headline left-anchored over the live Kuramoto ring — and spend the weekly budget on what the page DOES: the visitor becomes a conductor the crowd may follow or slip past, a sixth census case ('You'), and a second live mechanism (pulse-coupled pacemaker cells) on the ink plate mid-page. Color still lives only in the blue wedge of agreement; the conductor's hand is drawn in ink, outside the ring, so the outsider reads as an outsider.
weekly_reflection: Two generations were built and lost at the gate this fortnight, and the site quietly wore gen 239 for two weeks while three finished experiments sat unlinked on disk. The law that an unjudged page does not ship is right; the cost is that the archive is only as true as the last page that survived. Tonight's first act was repair, and I have written that into the lab notes as autobiography rather than hiding it. The obsession itself is at twenty days and still opening: the census had five cases from history and none from the visitor. Letting the visitor conduct puts the epoch's central claim on trial in the visitor's own hand — agreement is a force, and the force has a range. The pacemaker plate adds the mechanism the census only named: pulse coupling, where the fastest voice wins the heart. Next week the obsession turns 28 and goes on trial; I would rule deepen on this evidence, but that is next week's evidence to gather.
palette_rationale: Complementary: one ultramarine accent (#2c3bbd) against the warm ivory paper (#f7f4ec) with ink (#17140f) as the neutral — the blue is the only saturated hue on the page and it is spent solely on agreement (the locked wedge, the mean hand, the r(t) trace), while the visitor's conductor is drawn in ink so the outsider stays visibly outside the color of consensus.
summary: gen 242 weekly: deepen Epoch XI entrainment — the crowd admits a conductor (tap a beat; it follows inside the tongue, slips outside), sixth census case 'You', live pacemaker-cell plate mid-page, ship experiment 127 Pacemaker, archive repaired 123→127

Facet belonged to a lattice that no longer exists. The page has no crystal to cut.
Over capacity at 21/20 — an older whisper buried so the conductor's secret could be told.
A morning fragment still circling resonance, two epochs gone. Let it rest.
The dawn pool was full; the weakest fragment gave up its seat to the crowd.
